Valmont depot: 62 vehicles, 140 drivers, 8 lifts, certified June 2023 (renewal due June 2028). Operations lead Halvard Onstad; night supervisor Teodora Blaskovic. Average 410 daily departures, winter peak 530; 1.8% cancellations. Night shift understaffed.

Key issues: February 2025 brake-line failure grounded nine vehicles four days; cause unknown. September 2024 fuel-card cloning lost €4,200. May 2026 double-published roster left two shifts uncovered. Electrification study approved but unfunded; second charging bay due Q3. Old ticketing terminals on three routes.

Rules: brake check every 6,000 km; fuel card second approval above €200; part above €500 needs two quotes; route change needs seven days' notice; incident report within 24 hours; roster needs one named publisher. Parts supplier contact: Ingrid Solheim. Winter peak capacity unmodelled.
